texts.en: Inhabitants of [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName] have observed that [planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName] is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome period of reflection bring us closer to our ideals in future.
